angular_atlas_definition.interface_values_and_angular_jets: same whole functions on both sides
angular_atlas_definition.interface_radial_jets: one-sided; coordinates side=coast default, or left/right explicitly
angular_atlas_definition.positive_U_xi: positive convex combinations of original/seed/frozen-exit derivatives, and R139 D>0 within coast
angular_atlas_definition.coordinate_metric: (1+a_delta^2 U_s^2) ds^2+2 a_delta^2 U_s U_xi ds dxi+a_delta^2 U_xi^2 dxi^2
angular_atlas_definition.field_interface: shared P1 coefficient value and common full physical lifting trace; U_s continuity is not assumed

reference_evaluation_definition.method: R139 native_from_inlet at known frozen inlet label; no material inverse
reference_evaluation_definition.cache: bounded recent 64 scalar-s/full-label pairs, actual label equality and requested material composition checked
